method: 0-30 cm depth-weighted 5:10:15, dg/kg divided by 10 (pH x10 divided by 10)
confidence_note: SoilGrids is a 250 m model estimate; PRD section 6.4: soil is at best medium; AWC is an estimated pedotransfer output (Saxton & Rawls 2006), not a measured value
soc_class_rule: low < 10, medium 10-20, high > 20 g/kg (domain/thresholds.json, pending Younes)
awc_method: Saxton & Rawls (2006) Soil Sci Soc Am J 70:1569-1578 Table 1 Eqs 1-2 pedotransfer from ISRIC SoilGrids sand/silt/clay + SOC (OM = SOC x 1.724)
awc_check: texture fractions sum to ~100%; pedotransfer inputs consistent
